documents.content:
# Remote work policy

Employees may work remotely up to three days per week with manager approval.

# Engineering handbook

All customer-facing changes require peer review before release. Production incidents must have a written postmortem.

# Finance controls

Invoices above 10000 require approval from the finance lead before payment.

cases.query: How many days can employees work remotely?
What is required before a customer-facing release?
Who approves invoices above 10000 before payment?
What is the office parking allowance?
